title: Flat-pack from the retail park
setting: Petrol station and retail park · Level 2
settingFa: پمپ بنزین و مرکز خرید حاشیه شهر

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Right. Retail park: done. One wardrobe, flat-pack, for your room. Now the hard part. Will it fit in the car?

translations.fa: خب. مرکز خرید: تموم. یه کمد لباس، جعبه‌ای، برای اتاقت. حالا بخش سخت. تو ماشین جا میشه؟

branches.suggestion: I don't know. The box is very long!
Let's put the back seats down.

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: Good thinking. Seats down. Now — it's heavy. Can you give me a hand? You take that end. On three. One, two, three!

translations.fa: فکر خوبیه. صندلی‌ها خوابید. حالا — سنگینه. کمکم می‌کنی؟ تو اون سر را بگیر. با سه. یک، دو، سه!

branches.suggestion: Got it! Push it in slowly.

cultureNote.en: A "retail park" is a group of big shops outside town with a large free car park. People go there for furniture, DIY and electricals.
cultureNote.fa: مرکز خرید حاشیهٔ شهر با پارکینگ بزرگ رایگان.

recasts.echo: It's too heavy? Bend your knees!

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: Bend your knees, not your back! My back's forty-two years old. It's in. Just. The boot won't close, though.

translations.fa: زانوهات را خم کن، نه کمرت را! کمر من چهل و دو سالشه. رفت تو. به‌زور. ولی درِ صندوق بسته نمیشه.

branches.suggestion: What can we do? Do we have a rope?
Should we ask for delivery instead?

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Delivery's forty pounds. I've got a bungee cord. Very professional. We'll drive slowly. Like Nana Maggie.

translations.fa: تحویل چهل پونده. من کش بار دارم. خیلی حرفه‌ای. آروم رانندگی می‌کنیم. مثل ننه مگی.

branches.suggestion: Is it legal? With the boot open?

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: It's fine if it's tied down and doesn't stick out too far. Right — home! Then the real nightmare: the instructions.

translations.fa: اگه محکم بسته باشه و زیاد بیرون نزنه مشکلی نیست. خب — خونه! بعد کابوس واقعی: دستورالعمل.

branches.suggestion: Why are the instructions a nightmare?

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: No words. Only pictures. A little smiling man. Two hundred screws. And one is always missing. Always.

translations.fa: بدون کلمه. فقط عکس. یه آدمک کوچیکِ خندون. دویست تا پیچ. و همیشه یکی کمه. همیشه.

branches.suggestion: We can do it together. Step by step.
branches.suggestionFa: با هم می‌تونیم. قدم به قدم.

branches.suggestion: Do we have the right tools?

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: There's an Allen key in the box. Tiny. Useless. But I've got a drill. Ryan can help — he's good with screws. And pizza.

translations.fa: یه آچار آلن تو جعبه هست. ریزه. بی‌فایده. ولی من دریل دارم. رایان می‌تونه کمک کنه — با پیچ واردِه. و با پیتزا.

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: Kind? I just want my car back. Belt on. Off we go, nice and slow — and if you hear a crash, don't look back!

translations.fa: مهربون؟ فقط ماشینم را پس می‌خوام. کمربند ببند. راه افتادیم، آروم و آهسته — اگه صدای تق شنیدی، برنگرد نگاه کنی!
